title: Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K
sourceFolder: 2. Pattern Sliding Window/2. Maximum Sum Subarray of Size K (easy)

examples.raw:

Explanation: Subarray with maximum sum is [5, 1, 3].

Input: [2, 3, 4, 1, 5], k=2 
Output: 7
Explanation: Subarray with maximum sum is [3, 4].

sections.title: Problem Statement
sections.html:
Given an array of positive numbers and a positive number ‘k’, find the maximum sum of any contiguous subarray of size ‘k’.

sections.title: A better approach
sections.html:
If you observe closely, you will realize that to calculate the sum of a contiguous subarray we can utilize the sum of the previous subarray. For this, consider each subarray as a Sliding Window of size ‘k’. To calculate the sum of the next subarray, we need to slide the window ahead by one element. So to slide the window forward and calculate the sum of the new position of the sliding window, we need to do two things:

  1. Subtract the element going out of the sliding window i.e., subtract the first element of the window.
  2. Add the new element getting included in the sliding window i.e., the element coming right after the end of the window.

This approach will save us from re-calculating the sum of the overlapping part of the sliding window. Here is what our algorithm will look like:

Output

Maximum sum of a subarray of size K: 9 Maximum sum of a subarray of size K: 7

code.python3:
def max_sub_array_of_size_k(k, arr):
  max_sum , window_sum = 0, 0
  window_start = 0

  for window_end in range(len(arr)):
    window_sum += arr[window_end]  # add the next element
    # slide the window, we don't need to slide if we've not hit the required window size of 'k'
    if window_end >= k-1:
      max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum)
      window_sum -= arr[window_start]  # subtract the element going out
      window_start += 1  # slide the window ahead
  return max_sum


def main():
  print("Maximum sum of a subarray of size K: " + str(max_sub_array_of_size_k(3, [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2])))
  print("Maximum sum of a subarray of size K: " + str(max_sub_array_of_size_k(2, [2, 3, 4, 1, 5])))

main()
